notes.title: Cavern Playtest - Round 2!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p]This is Brendan, the sole developer behind Cavern. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope y'all are doing well. It's about time that I release a new playtest and get some more feedback for Cavern! [/p][p]Any feedback (positive or negative) is welcome, and certainly helps shape the game.[/p][p][/p][p]There are a few know bugs and points of confusion (no clear tutorial, etc.), but this demo has the first 3 playable characters and is a pretty decent vertical slice of the game. [/p][p][b]To Report Bugs:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Please fill out and submit this google form: [url="https://forms.gle/bo7NmmwvQEL669JU9"]https://forms.gle/bo7NmmwvQEL669JU9[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Please join the [url="https://discord.gg/6BxwYQdpM7"]DogmaQuest discord[/url] and share your thoughts in #playtesting-feedback![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Currently, there are a few ways to get the max damage and one shot the boss. I hope you guys can find em.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Don't hesitate to reach out with questions![/p][p][/p][p]-Brendan[/p][p]"dogmaquest"[/p]

notes.title: Cavern Limited Beta Testing Now Open
notes.notes:
Hello!
This is Brendan Roarty the developer of Cavern. 

[b]I am happy to announce that Beta Testing for Cavern is Live![/b]

Please see the "join" button on the steam page if you are interested in trying out the game and potentially providing feedback. 

Please submit bug reports, or things you enjoyed about the game (negative and positive feedback!) in the feedback form linked below. The goal is to mitigate what the game does wrong (bugs etc.) and strengthen the concepts it gets right (if any at all!)

[url=https://forms.gle/5iJeJy914sYpYzAFA]Feedback Form Link[/url]

If you are interested in suggesting content for the game ("you should add a sword that one shots everything and has a 10% chance to end your run" - guy with a great idea) please drop it in the discord, and not through the form.

[url=https://discord.gg/6BxwYQdpM7]Join the Discord Here[/url]

As always, thank you for reading this and expressing interest in the game! I wouldn't be doing this without those who enjoy the games, and it is my goal to make those experiences not only worthwhile, but continuously better over time. I am grateful for your help.

If you are interested in supporting me, check out my other games on steam or see them all on my [url=https://dogma.quest/]official website![/url]

Thank you,
Brendan Roarty
Dogma Quest
